title: Presentation and scalar transitivity for the native proper scalar mate
statement:
Fix a prime $l$, normalized native inverse-image data NativeRings, a finite unlifted coefficient index $E$, and a completed-to-native Change $a$ agreeing with every normalized integralMap [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data], [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Write $A_T$ for the completed section-module category for the size model Coefficient $E$, $I_T$ for internal modules over the pulled condensed integers of the original finite field $E$, $F_T$ for internal modules over its pulled condensed field, $B_T$ for internal modules over the finite-subextension-valued pulled condensed algebraic closure, and $N_T$ for native section modules. Write $L_T:D(I_T)\to D(F_T)$ and $Q_T:D(F_T)\to D(B_T)$ for the canonical derived extensions [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], $\lambda_{g,C}$ for localizedDirectImageComparison [lem-sfb-localized-direct-image-comparison], and $\beta_{g,K}$ for derivedPushHom for the finite-field inclusion into the algebraic closure [def-sfb-derived-push-hom], [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]. For every scheme morphism $g:U\to V$, there exist additive equivalences $e:A_U\simeq I_U$ and $d:B_V\simeq N_V$ such that, for every ordinary unbounded $M\in D(A_U)$, the arrow $(\operatorname{properComparison}(a,g))_M$ is isomorphic in $\operatorname{Arr}(D(N_V))$ to
$$
D(d)\bigl(Q_V(\lambda_{g,D(e)(M)})\mathbin{;}\beta_{g,L_U(D(e)(M))}\bigr).
$$
Here semicolon denotes first the left arrow and then the right arrow. Both derived equivalences are induced by the additive exact ordinary equivalences. This identifies arrows through their source and target coefficient-transport isomorphisms; it asserts no invertibility of either comparison and assumes neither properness nor boundedness.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary ring diagram from exists_nativeScalarRingModel. Its explicitly constructed integral and closure module equivalences are additive exact equivalences. Apply nativeScalarRestrictionCube to get their restriction comparisons and the commuting derived direct-image cube.

Take inverse mates of the cube. The coefficient-presentation faces have invertible inverse mates because their horizontal functors are equivalences (proved privately using the opposite adjunctions and isIso_mateEquiv_of_isEquivalence). Mathlib mateEquiv_vcomp and the top/bottom whiskering identities turn the right-adjoint cube into a commuting left-adjoint square. At each M, its two invertible sides give an Arrow.isoMk after applying the closure derived equivalence; the mapArrowEquivalence unit transports it back. This is the private scalarMateArrowTransport proof, and does not require either geometric scalar mate invertible.

Use the proved nativeScalarDerivedCompositeMate, which applies Mathlib mateEquiv_hcomp to the two canonical condensed scalar adjunctions and expands their component formula. Unfold only the specified condensed composite and localized comparison to identify this with nativeScalarCondensedComposite. The native inverse mate is properComparison by definition. Substitute into the proved arrow transport, giving the original existential conclusion unchanged.

theorem native_proper_scalar_mate_presentation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [N : NativeRings.{u} l]
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
      (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (ha : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u})
      (C : CoefficientPresentation l T (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) (embedding l E)),
      a.map T = C.integralMap l T)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V) :
    ∃ (e : pbcModules U ((PurCompactSupport.completed l
          (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring U) ≌
        Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) U))
      (d : Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) V) ≌
        pbcModules V ((nativeCoefficients l).ring V))
      (he : e.functor.Additive) (hd : d.functor.Additive),
      letI := he
      letI := hd
      ∀ M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U ((PurCompactSupport.completed l
          (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring U)),
        Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((PurCompactSupport.properComparison a g).app M) ≅
          Arrow.mk (d.functor.mapDerivedCategory.map
            (nativeScalarCondensedComposite l E g
              (e.functor.mapDerivedCategory.obj M))))
